_doc: Everything about this paper that the page shows as data. mk_paper.py turns it into the headline card (parts/_gen_card.html), Further reading (parts/_gen_more.html) and the tables' data (parts/_gen_data.js). Every paper page has one of these; see PAPER_METHOD.md.
title: Attention Is All You Need
authors: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, Illia Polosukhin
lab: Google Brain, Google Research, University of Toronto

code.title: tensor2tensor
code.note: the authors' code (repo, about 20 minutes for the README and entry path); now deprecated in favour of Trax

takeaway: Replaced recurrence entirely with multi-head scaled dot-product self-attention, making sequence training parallel and becoming the backbone of every modern LLM.

headline.k: WMT 2014 English to German, big model
headline.d: over 2 BLEU above every earlier model, ensembles included

headline.k: WMT 2014 English to French, big model
headline.d: new single-model state of the art at under 1/4 the training cost

headline.k: to train the base model (65M parameters)
headline.d: 3.3 × 10<sup>18</sup> FLOPs, already past every earlier EN-DE result

resources.n: still the canonical visual walkthrough of Q/K/V, multi-head attention and the encoder-decoder data flow.
the paper reimplemented line by line in PyTorch; the fastest route from equations to working code.
the best geometric intuition for what attention heads actually compute.
builds a decoder-only Transformer from an empty file; makes the causal masking and multi-head mechanics concrete.

a live GPT-2 small running in your browser: type a prompt and inspect every attention head and the sampling step. Its paper is arXiv 2408.04619 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.04619). The idea this page's Run a Transformer tab borrows, at toy scale and encoder-decoder.
a 3D walk through every matrix multiply of a small GPT (nano-gpt) at true shape, step by step.

kb.n: 2018: the encoder stack alone, pretrained bidirectionally.
2020: the decoder stack scaled; the parallelism this paper unlocked is what made those curves reachable.
2020: loss as a power law in parameters, data and compute, measured on Transformers.
2021: rotary embeddings replace the sinusoidal positional encoding.
2022: exact attention made IO-aware; attacks the memory traffic this architecture created.
2023: pages the KV cache like virtual memory to serve many sequences.
2020: the same encoder applied to image patches.
2023: the main post-Transformer attempt to remove the O(n²) attention core.
2019: the encoder-decoder kept and scaled, every task as text to text.

topics.n: the ancestor of every model family covered there.
what a 2026 block looks like across 90-odd open models: norms, attention variants, KV cache.
